scope: Initial researched batch of independent and distinctive bars. Listings must have an official website or direct OpenTable listing and a currently sourced rating of at least 4.0/5. Ratings and sources should be rechecked periodically. The directory covers 18 Latin American countries; additional countries remain to be researched.
